name: aaro-store
description: AARO — MERN clothing store: API server, storefront and admin panel

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,store,admin -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix admin run build:server
